profile_text: With a focus on auditing and tax consulting, this professional services firm has experienced significant growth, increasing its workforce by 40% since the baseline. As a scaler in the professional, scientific, and technical activities sector, it has expanded to 56 employees in 2024, driven by demand for its specialized services. The company's expertise in Wirtschaftsprüfung (auditing) and Steuerberatung (tax consulting) has enabled it to capitalize on market opportunities and drive its expansion.
